title: Occasions dialogue and questions
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Ali Baba and the forty thieves; occasions
source: Seeded from arabic/y6 lesson 12 (Pupil PDF worksheet: occasions dialogue and questions)
intro: Read the text carefully. Annotate it: underline key words and write your ideas in the margin.

arabic.text:
سَارَة: كَيْفَ كَانَ رَمَضَانُ؟
زَيْنَب: الحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ، صُمْتُ وَقَرَأْتُ القُرْآنَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
سَارَة: وَمَاذَا فَعَلْتِ يَوْمَ العِيدِ؟
زَيْنَب: صَلَّيْتُ صَلَاةَ العِيدِ، وَزُرْتُ جَدَّتِي.
سَارَة: عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ! تَقَبَّلَ اللهُ مِنَّا وَمِنْكُمْ.

questions.q: What did Zaynab do in Ramadan? Answer in Arabic.
questions.model: Teacher finds the line: صُمْتُ وَقَرَأْتُ القُرْآنَ. Change 'I' to 'she': صَامَتْ وَقَرَأَتِ القُرْآنَ.

questions.q: Dialogue task on the pupil PDF: answer four questions, then write your own four-line Eid dialogue with a partner and perform it (breakout, then two pairs share).
questions.a: Answers from the text; own dialogue with greetings and past verbs
questions.model: Teacher writes line 1 of a new dialogue: أَحْمَد: عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ يَا يُوسُفُ!

questions.q: add a line about Eid al-Adha.
questions.a: For example: فِي عِيدِ الأَضْحَى أَكَلْنَا مِنَ الأُضْحِيَةِ.
